meta.note: 非官方风格参考，从 VoltAgent/awesome-design-md（MIT）中 The Verge 的 DESIGN.md 转换而来；原字体多为商用，families 里排在后面的 Google 字体是替代。

tokens.name: jelly-mint
tokens.usage: The Verge's signature acid-mint accent. Used as CTA button fill, link underlines, active tab borders, and high-attention story-tile backgrounds. Treat it as the visual equivalent of neon safety paint — applied sparingly to the most important element on screen.

tokens.name: verge-ultraviolet
tokens.usage: The complementary brand hazard. Used for secondary color-block tiles, promotional spans, and the occasional outlined button. Often applied at 0.9 alpha to soften its cathode intensity.

tokens.name: console-mint-border
tokens.usage: A darker variant of the jelly mint used on card outlines and button borders where pure mint would over-saturate.

tokens.name: deep-link-blue
tokens.usage: The link *hover* color — the one moment blue appears on the site. It replaces mint/white/black on hover across every link style.

tokens.name: focus-cyan
tokens.usage: Reserved for button focus rings. Never shown outside a keyboard-focus state.

tokens.name: purple-rule
tokens.usage: A darker ultraviolet variant used as the vertical border on StoryStream `<li>` items.

tokens.name: canvas-black
tokens.usage: The default dark surface for the entire homepage. Almost-but-not-quite pure black — has just enough warmth to feel like a printed newsprint negative rather than an OLED void.

tokens.name: surface-slate
tokens.usage: Secondary card background, used when a story tile doesn't need to be a saturated color block.

tokens.name: image-frame
tokens.usage: The 1px border that wraps inline imagery.

tokens.name: hazard-white
tokens.usage: Used as story-tile fill, button border, and primary text. When white appears as a large block, it's an editorial decision — a "spotlight" on that tile.

tokens.name: absolute-black
tokens.usage: Reserved for text on the mint/yellow/white tiles — the only place it appears.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Headlines and display text on the canvas.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Bylines, timestamps, photo credits. The mid-gray that anchors the metadata layer.

tokens.name: muted-text
tokens.usage: Button text on dark slate buttons. Slightly off-white to reduce screen glare.

tokens.name: inverted-text
tokens.usage: Used only on accent tiles (mint, yellow, white) to keep contrast legible.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus only.

tokens.name: overlay-black
tokens.usage: Subtle 1px ring used as the quiet shadow alternative on stacked cards.

tokens.name: dim-gray
tokens.usage: Active/pressed button background — the "pressed down" state.
